$comment: Template for character database with pose library system. Weapons defined with handedness; poses reference reusable library templates.

metadata.title: Character Prompt Template
metadata.description: Template for pose library system - weapons defined separately, poses reference reusable templates with placeholders
metadata.architecture: Pose library system with weapon injection, validation, and prop visibility modes

thematic_rules.description: Theme-specific rules applied to all prompts
thematic_rules.prompt_snippet: heroic fantasy character, dramatic lighting, strong silhouette

pose_library_system.description: Poses are defined in rules/pose_library.json as reusable templates with placeholders
pose_library_system.weapon_separation: Weapons defined on character.weapons object, separate from poses
pose_library_system.composition: At generation time, weapon descriptions replace MAIN_HAND_PROP/OFF_HAND_PROP placeholders in pose templates
pose_library_system.validation: System checks pose handedness_mode and prop_class match character weapons

weapon_structure.main_hand: Primary weapon held in main hand (or both hands for two-handed weapons)
weapon_structure.off_hand: Secondary weapon or item in off hand (null if empty)
weapon_structure.holstered: Array of items carried but not actively held (sheathed, slung, stowed)

pose_structure.pose_library_ref: ID of pose template in pose_library.json (e.g., 'melee_001_guarded_low_ready')

prop_override.off_hand_prop_state: Optional: state override for off hand
prop_override.off_hand_orientation: Optional: orientation override for off hand

handedness_modes.unarmed: No weapons in hands (fists, claws, empty)
handedness_modes.single_handed: One weapon in main hand, off hand empty or gesturing
handedness_modes.two_handed: Both hands on same weapon (bows, two-handed swords, staves)
handedness_modes.dual_wield: Different weapon in each hand (sword+shield, dual pistols)

prop_visibility_modes.presented: Weapon fully visible with clear negative space, held away from torso (default)
prop_visibility_modes.carried_attached: Weapon carried by equipment (sling/strap), overlap allowed at attachment zones
